inputs.text:
It is an absolute disgrace to our legal system and our foundational values when activist judges completely subvert the rule of law to advance a radical culture of death. Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a vital prolife law under the absurd pretext that limiting abortion supposedly violates freedom of religion. 

This whole assault on traditional morality and the sanctity of life was brought forward by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, who actually had the audacity to claim that protecting unborn children “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” 

When secular progressive organizations and fringe groups weaponize the courts to enshrine abortion as a sacred religious rite, they are spitting in the face of natural law, family values, and the millions of Americans who believe in basic human decency and the right to life. This is precisely why our communities and our constitutional order are unraveling—because rogue judges like Judge Christina R. [...] prioritize progressive judicial activism over the preservation of innocent life and our enduring moral heritage.
